description: Rollout history of one Kubernetes Deployment over the last 30 minutes: the ScalingReplicaSet events (which ReplicaSet scaled up or down, from how many pods to how many, and when). Use it to line up a release or a rollback with the error rate, and to check whether an old ReplicaSet already reached zero pods.

configuration.query:
FROM logs-k8seventsreceiver.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 30 minutes
    AND attributes.k8s.namespace.name == ?namespace
    AND k8s.object.kind == "Deployment" AND k8s.object.name == ?deployment
    AND k8s.event.reason == "ScalingReplicaSet"
| KEEP @timestamp, body.text
| SORT @timestamp
